description: Compute configuration for bindi's fleet functions on Modal. This file is the single source of truth for every machine spec: modal_app.py reads it at import time and uses it to parameterise each @app.function(...) decorator, because Modal fixes cpu/memory/gpu/timeout at deploy time, not at run time. A spec change therefore takes effect by redeploying a commit, never by editing invisible cloud state. Named modal_infra.json, not infra.json: wetware-hq/wing keeps a different infra.json at fleets/NYESO1-A0201/infra.json which is the CAMPAIGN infrastructure record. Same filename, different job; the name here is explicit about which one it is.
gpu_statement: No function here declares a GPU. Boltz is the generator and stays on the hosted design API behind the human spend gate; self-hosting Boltz is out of scope by standing instruction, so no GPU container is declared for generation. BindCraft-on-Modal, which did require a GPU, has been removed from the design path. A GPU key is added here only when a specific function genuinely needs one and that need has been approved.

run_gates.purpose: Both output gates (human-reference homology and hazard screen) with real mmseqs2 and BLAST+. Fails closed; returns bindi's gate records verbatim.

curate_campaign.purpose: Read a ranked table under project_folder and build a bindi.gallery.v1 gallery.

case_run.purpose: One synthetic immunology case end to end, writing one JSONL trace. The design hold and the margin refusal are enforced inside bindi, unchanged by running remotely.

ipsae_score.purpose: CPU ipSAE scoring from Boltz PAE matrices and predicted CIF structures. Numeric, no model weights, no GPU.

sequence_design_repeat_noise.purpose: Repeat-noise distribution for the sequence-level designer across independent seeds. Sequence-level only: it is explicitly not structure-validated and never clears the margin stage.
